Codelibrary(tidyverse)

# Load the dataset directly from GitHub
coffee_survey <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2024/2024-05-14/coffee_survey.csv")

top_reasons <- coffee_survey |>
  filter(!is.na(why_drink)) |>
  separate_rows(why_drink, sep = ",\\s*") |>
  count(why_drink, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(pct_of_respondents = round(n / sum(!is.na(coffee_survey$why_drink)) * 100, 1))

print(top_reasons)

# A tibble: 5 × 3
  why_drink                          n pct_of_respondents

1 It tastes good                  3355               94  
2 I need the caffeine             2021               56.6
3 I need the ritual               1922               53.9
4 It makes me go to the bathroom   465               13  
5 Other                            168                4.7



Attempted to see if there is any relationships between age and reasons for drinking coffee.


Codelibrary(tidyverse)

coffee_survey <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2024/2024-05-14/coffee_survey.csv")

coffee_survey |>
  filter(!is.na(why_drink)) |>
  # Standardize order of reasons inside each string so "A, B" and "B, A" match
  mutate(
    combo = map_chr(str_split(why_drink, ",\\s*"), ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = " + "))
  ) |>
  count(combo, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(combo, n))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#6F4E37", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Combinations of Reasons People Drink Coffee",
    x = "Number of Respondents",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

title: Appendix A — Caffeine Intake as a Function of Coffee Preferences
text: Project Goal: Our project intends to investigate how varying coffee preferences affect caffeine usage. We plan to test different variables such as time of day (when making the coffee), cream use, coffee type, etc., and see how that impacts the amount of caffeine someone consumes.

Broad Research Questions:

What are the trends and general preferences of coffee drinkers in the US?
What factors influence coffee intake?
What are the top influencers in consumer decisions to drink coffee at home vs. out?
What do people add when making their ideal order/coffee?
